prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: parking lot collision in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1034; do not mention it.)
text: I was backing out of a parking space at the grocery store on the east side of Pasadena, Texas, moving slowly and checking my mirrors. As I reversed, the rear of my vehicle struck the side of a silver sedan that was passing behind me in the aisle. I stopped immediately, put my car in park, and got out to look at the damage. Both vehicles had visible scrapes and my rear bumper was cracked. The other driver and I exchanged insurance information, and a store employee took a photo of the scene. Later that day I began experiencing neck stiffness and pain radiating into my shoulders, which I was later diagnosed with as whiplash. I am submitting this statement with my claim and am willing to provide medical records and repair estimates upon request.
